result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The scoping and convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass. I didn't add new tests for these patterns, so the `.htm`, `<doc>` XML and `build-gradle.js` cases are not checked directly.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, which listed `html` twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **`.NET` `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path patterns were `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file named exactly `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`. The `<doc>` and `// Generated by` content checks still apply, so hand-written `.xml` and `.js` files stay out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** the pattern `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` lands in the build-and-deployment scope. `build.gradle` is still covered by the separate `.*[.]gradle` rule.

I did not commit.
